title: Widget IDs
description:
Work out the ID ImGui gives a widget from its label and the ID stack.

```
"Save" in window "Tools"          -> id of Tools/Save
"Save##2" in window "Tools"       -> shows "Save", id of Tools/Save##2
"Score: 10###score"               -> shows "Score: 10", id of Tools/###score (stays the same when the score changes)
PushID(3) then "Delete"           -> id of Tools/3/Delete
```
hints: `label.find("##")` finds the start of the hidden part; check for `"###"` first, because it also contains `"##"` (lesson 1.05).
Real ImGui hashes each part into the previous seed, so equal stacks give equal IDs; the joined string shows the same idea.
requirements: `idSource(label)`: the whole label, or only from `###` onwards when there is one.
A stack of strings joined with `/` stands in for the hashed ID stack.
stretch: Detect two widgets in one frame with the same ID and report the clash, as ImGui's debug tool does.
